entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 201574982848108416 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/an-aur/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv; cross-identification HIP 23210: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia+DR3+201574982848108416. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AN Aur: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 5301.6 +/- 463.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 5301.6 +/- 463.4 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2494 +/- 0.0183 mas (same row, RUWE 1.21), 13.6 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -0.427, -1.515 mas/yr. Radial velocity: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 201574982848108416 (quality A), from 2012ApJ...748..107P; Gaia DR3 measures none (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...748..107P/abstract).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 93.6 +/- 8.1 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AN Aur: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 93.6 +/- 8.1 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 65,117,520 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 153 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 14, Name='AN Aur', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 153 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 201574982848108416: 4 G-band harmonics of a 10.2875587752036 d period, peak-to-peak 0.617 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.02 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,500 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.6 +/- 0.057 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffede1. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,500 K and log g 1.94 (u1 0.499, u2 0.228): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 1.94 from 2011AJ....141...53S; the 2 published values span log g 1.94 to 2.13, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness.
